reply.note: Type what the patient told you, or pick a reply that was stored earlier. A suggested reading is only a suggestion: you decide. The red-flag rules read the reply first.

reply.typeLabel: The patient's reply, as they gave it (by phone or in person)

reply.saveConflict: A different reply was already saved with this request. Check what you typed and save again.
reply.saveInvalid: The reply is blank or too long. Nothing was saved.
reply.saveNotFound: This patient is not registered at this clinic. Nothing was saved.
